sentences.en: They say that language is a virus from outer space.
sentences.zh: 他们说语言是一种来自外太空的病毒。

sentences.en: Between the inner and outer planets is an asteroid belt.
sentences.zh: 内行星和外行星之间有一条小行星带。

sentences.en: The outer part of the ear is made of cartilage.
sentences.zh: 耳朵外部是由软骨构成的。

senses.zh: 外面的，外部的；远离中心的
